svg.text: RUN 1'S RESERVED MEMORY AT THE FAILURE, EVERY SEGMENT TO SCALE (ALLOCATOR SNAPSHOT)
37 segments of 384 MiB: a live 256 MiB tensor and a free 128 MiB tail
27 live segments of 256 MiB: 16 weights, 11 gradients and Adam states
12 segments of the optimizer's temporaries: live at the failure, freed as the error unwound
Reserved 23.63 GiB in 77 segments (one 2 MiB small-pool segment not drawn). A tail never merges across its live head or into another segment.
